name: Trim Paint Prep — Template (Post-Primer)
intent: Canonical post-primer trim prep — inspect, light sand, touch up fill/caulk, patch, dust. Extended by per-substrate MOD_PREP_<substrate>_PAINT modules; each substrate's PS_SURFACE_LF.<substrate> is wired via the scenario engine, not the module.
doctrine: Default height:true matches the majority of trim substrates (crown, picture rail, window stool/apron/casing/jamb, shadow box, panel mold). Floor-adjacent substrates (baseboard, shoe mold, chair rail) and door-frame/casing override height:false.
